editorial_policy.headings: Preserve original heading capitalization and retained wording. Only recorded boilerplate removal, hierarchy repairs, added grouping headings and intact section moves apply.
editorial_policy.spacing: Remove horizontal rules outside fences and collapse repeated outside-fence blank lines.
editorial_policy.preservation: Every original heading node retains its ordered direct body after spacing normalization; only the redundant style subtitle preamble merges into the title preamble. Fenced example blocks retain their full contents and multiplicity.
editorial_policy.digests: content_sha256 hashes the sorted exact non-heading prose-line multiset; examples_sha256 hashes the sorted complete fenced-block multiset. Each uses UTF-8 compact JSON with sorted keys and ensure_ascii=false.
